title: vigil-sre · Latency phases
description: Where the time goes: DNS, TCP, TLS, backend, transfer. Opens on the last 7 days; widen the range if the mounted database holds older probes. The percentile tables cover every probe in the mounted database, whatever the range.

panels.title: TTFB — time to first byte
panels.description: The measure closest to 'how long did it take'.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%s', run_started_at) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.google.com' THEN ttfb_ms END) AS "google.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.github.com' THEN ttfb_ms END) AS "github.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.cloudflare.com' THEN ttfb_ms END) AS "cloudflare.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://httpbin.org/status/200' THEN ttfb_ms END) AS "httpbin.org"
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: TTFB percentiles (ms)
panels.description: Nearest-rank with CUME_DIST — the same method as --report.

targets.queryText:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT url, ttfb_ms AS v,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY url ORDER BY ttfb_ms) AS cd
  FROM probe_results WHERE ttfb_ms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT url AS target, COUNT(*) AS n,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END)) AS p50,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.95 THEN v END)) AS p95,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.99 THEN v END)) AS p99,
  ROUND(MAX(v)) AS max
FROM r GROUP BY url ORDER BY p95 DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
